parameters.query:
SELECT
  c.id AS candidate_id,
  c.name,
  c.phone,
  c.absence_rate,
  c.late_rate,
  c.no_reply_count,
  c.reliability_score,
  c.last30d_missions,
  c.avg_response_time_minutes,
  m.id AS mission_id,
  m.ats_mission_id,
  m.mission_date,
  m.start_time,
  m.location,
  m.skill_required,
  m.status AS current_status,
  m.recruiter_id,
  m.reminder_1_sent_at,
  m.reminder_2_sent_at,
  m.reminder_3_sent_at,
  m.confirmed_at,
  -- Time between reminder_1 and confirmation (response_time proxy)
  CASE WHEN m.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND m.reminder_1_sent_at IS NOT NULL
    THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (m.confirmed_at - m.reminder_1_sent_at)) / 60
    ELSE NULL
  END AS response_time_minutes,
  -- Count recent missions in last 30 days
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM missions m2
    WHERE m2.ats_candidate_id = c.ats_candidate_id
    AND m2.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  ) AS recent_mission_count,
  r.email AS recruiter_email,
  r.slack_user_id AS recruiter_slack
FROM candidates c
JOIN missions m ON m.id = {{ $json.mission_id }}
LEFT JOIN recruiters r ON r.id = m.recruiter_id
WHERE c.id = {{ $json.candidate_id }}
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE missions SET
  risk_score = {{ $json.risk_score }},
  risk_level = '{{ $json.risk_level }}',
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $json.mission_id }};

UPDATE candidates SET
  reliability_score = GREATEST(0, LEAST(100, 100 - {{ $json.risk_score }})),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $json.candidate_id }};

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ mission_id: $json.mission_id, ats_mission_id: $json.ats_mission_id, skill_required: $json.skill_required, location: $json.location, mission_date: $json.mission_date, recruiter_id: $json.recruiter_id, reason: 'HIGH_RISK_AI_SCORING', risk_score: $json.risk_score }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, risk_score: $json.risk_score, risk_level: $json.risk_level, is_high_risk: $json.is_high_risk }) }}
